lead.description: the probability-weighted average of a loss, used to rank actions

overview_sentence: Expected loss is the probability-weighted average of a loss, and the preferred action minimises it.

self_checks.title: Low base rate
self_checks.prompt: Treat has losses 1 and 8, watch has losses 10 and 0, and the base rate is 0.2. What are the two expected losses?
self_checks.answer: Treat has expected loss 6.6 and watch has expected loss 2.

self_checks.title: High base rate
self_checks.prompt: The same losses with base rate 0.7. What are the two expected losses?
self_checks.answer: Treat has expected loss 3.1 and watch has expected loss 7.

self_checks.title: Which action
self_checks.prompt: At base rate 0.2, which action has the smaller expected loss?
